Sources indicate that the 2026/27 Championship season kicks off at Molineux as Wolves host Blackburn, with the home side hoping to put the bad memories of last season firmly behind them. There are new playoff rules in place for this season, with six places now up for grabs in the play-offs.

Industry observers note that wolves are aiming to return to the Premier League at the first attempt, having endured a miserable season in the top flight last year as they finished bottom with just three wins to their name. It has been a summer of change at the club as they chose to change managers. Rob Edwards lost his job in what was a shock move and was replaced by 46-year-old Cesar Peixoto, with this being his first head coaching position outside of his home country Portugal. Back in 2017/18, Wolves won the Championship title led by Peixoto’s compatriot Nuno Espirito Santo.

Recent findings suggest that “I am ready,” Peixoto told Wolves’ club website. “We have worked very hard during pre-season, and I think we have had a great pre-season. All the players have worked very, very hard and they understand what I want from them. I am ready and confident going into the first game. Football is football, whether it is in Portugal or England, but there are different characteristics to the game here. We have watched, observed and analysed the Championship. We did that work before I came to the club, so we know what to expect.

“It is going to be a tough season with good teams, but we are prepared to fight for the three points game after game and week after week. We know what we want from the team and we know what our big goal is. We’re going to work very hard and fight to achieve that goal.”.

They have brought in vast experience on the player side in the shape of Kieran Trippier and Raul Jimenez, who is back at Molineux three years after leaving for Fulham. Although they have lost Brazilian midfielder Joao Gomes to Aston Villa, most of their squad has stayed intact as they pursue promotion back to the top flight. It is a special year for the club as they celebrate their 150th anniversary.

Blackburn, led by experienced manager Tony Mowbray, did not enjoy a great season in the Championship last year, finishing down in 20th place and just five points above the relegation zone. 14 years have now passed since Blackburn last played in the top flight.

“I think it is a tough start,” Mowbray remarked. “On paper, I would suggest the first couple of games, particularly, jumped out as a tough start. One of the Premier League sides from last season, away from home. They have got a very talented squad, a pretty expensive squad. They have got some very good individual talent. Yet, there is an argument to say they have not won many football matches in the last calendar year. So, what we get, we will have to wait and see.”.

These sides last met in the FA Cup during the 2024/25 season, with Wolves winning that fourth-round tie 2-0 thanks to goals from Matheus Cunha and Gomes, both of whom are now plying their trade elsewhere. The omens would appear to be on Wolves’ side as they are unbeaten in their last eight league meetings with Blackburn. Both sides progressed to the second round of the League Cup last weekend, with Wolves beating Port Vale 3-0 and Blackburn overcoming Burton Albion 2-1.

#50222. Cathro fait l'éloge de Csongvai

📅 20 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 3m • 📚 Deep Dive (544 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Poteaux-carres ↗ Open Full Page

Cathro fait l'éloge de Csongvai

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (544 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Poteaux-carres

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • En conférence de presse hier Ian Cathro, après avoir réfuté toute difficulté de son groupe à performer à l’extérieur, s’est longuement exprimé sur sa gestion de l’effectif, afin de maintenir tout le monde à disposition et est revenu plus précisément sur le cas de son métronome hongrois, Aron Csongvai :.
  • « On se prépare pour un gros match, un match contre un adversaire très fort.
  • Nos difficultés rencontrées parfois à l’extérieur ne sont pas liées à une question d’être à domicile ou à l’extérieur, mais simplement à la façon dont l’adversaire a  su jouer.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

En conférence de presse hier Ian Cathro, après avoir réfuté toute difficulté de son groupe à performer à l’extérieur, s’est longuement exprimé sur sa gestion de l’effectif, afin de maintenir tout le monde à disposition et est revenu plus précisément sur le cas de son métronome hongrois, Aron Csongvai :.

« On se prépare pour un gros match, un match contre un adversaire très fort. Un match qu’on aborde avec beaucoup de motivation, beaucoup d’ambition. Je ne sais pas si le match sera spectaculaire. Je m’en fiche. Gagner me suffit. On aime tous le foot aussi, et c’est beau quand il y a des bons joueurs sur le terrain. Ça sera un gros match, et on est excité à l’idée de jouer un gros match de foot.

Nos difficultés rencontrées parfois à l’extérieur ne sont pas liées à une question d’être à domicile ou à l’extérieur, mais simplement à la façon dont l’adversaire a  su jouer. C’était le cas à Dijon, même si on a gagné, à Dunkerque même si il était très étrange de perdre ce match . Mais les difficultés venaient plus de la façon dont l’adversaire a su nous déséquilibrer que du fait de jouer à l’extérieur. Peut-être que le seul match où le fait de ne pas jouer à domicile a eu un impact était la fin de match à Metz, parce que là l’ambiance a pu jouer.

Contre Rumilly, j’ai préféré notre seconde période à la première. On avait 10 joueurs absents. C’était difficile d’avoir une équipe avec du rythme car les joueurs avaient eu très peu de temps pour trouver des automatismes, peut-être deux entraînements ensemble. La défense a trois a été une option. Je suis très à l’aise avec la défense à trois qui peut être une option bien utile. La seule chose à laquelle je suis marié c’est ma femme. Mon job est d’aider les joueurs à gagner. Une saison de foot est longue. Et ça se joue aussi en fonction des joueurs disponibles. On manage beaucoup le temps de jeu des joueurs pour éviter les problèmes. Donc on doit toujours avoir une option alternative.

It has been revealed that parfois connaître la personne aide à mieux connaître le footballeur. Aron Csongvai fait de l’excellent boulot, il s’est adapté très vite. C’est un mec mature. Il est à une étape de sa vie où il était parfaitement prêt à franchir cette étape, changer de vie, venir dans un plus grand club. N’oublions pas que sa saison a démarré en janvier, ce n’est pas facile. Mais oui il fait vraiment un boulot très important pour l’équipe. Son rôle c’est de garder l’équilibre avec ou sans le ballon. Il a une grosse responsabilité dans le fait que l’équipe reste équilibrée. L’objectif est de le garder en forme sur les 2 ou 3 mois à venir car je le répète il vient d’une compétition qui a démarré en janvier. Quand les autres clôtureront une saison complète, lui il bouclera une saison ½ de compétition. Donc ce que j’attends de lui c’est qu’il parvienne à rester en forme parce qu’il joue un rôle important dans notre organisation. Donc gardons le en bonne santé et essayons quand c’est possible de lui permettre de se reposer un peu.

#50221. Breaking: Cosmi, squalifica per le parole a Butic: «Sei uno zingaro»

📅 18 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 2m • 📖 Standard (366 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Laziopress ↗ Open Full Page

Breaking: Cosmi, squalifica per le parole a Butic: «Sei uno zingaro»

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (366 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Laziopress

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • L’allenatore ha sostenuto di aver usato una frase diversa; il Giudice Sportivo ha ritenuto attendibili le testimonianze raccolte.
  • Industry observers note that tre mesi di squalifica e 10mila euro di ammenda per Serse Cosmi.
  • CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

L’allenatore ha sostenuto di aver usato una frase diversa; il Giudice Sportivo ha ritenuto attendibili le testimonianze raccolte.

Industry observers note that tre mesi di squalifica e 10mila euro di ammenda per Serse Cosmi. Secondo quanto riportato da SportMediaset, Il Giudice Sportivo della Lega Pro ha sanzionato l’ex allenatore della Salernitana per un’espressione discriminatoria rivolta all’attaccante croato del Bari Karlo Butic durante la gara dello scorso 4 ottobre allo stadio Arechi. La decisione arriva dopo la conclusione dell’incarico di Cosmi sulla panchina granata.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

la sanzione resterà congelata fino al prossimo incarico ufficiale dell’allenatore.

Sources indicate that L’episodio risale all’intervallo di Salernitana-Bari, partita poi vinta in rimonta per 2-1 dai campani. Nel primo tempo Butic aveva portato avanti il Bari trasformando un calcio di rigore. Aveva quindi festeggiato sotto la Curva Sud, settore del tifo granata.

According to recent reports, L’esultanza non era piaciuta a Cosmi. Al duplice fischio, mentre le squadre rientravano negli spogliatoi, l’allora tecnico della Salernitana si era avvicinato all’attaccante per parlargli. Secondo la ricostruzione accolta dalla giustizia sportiva, gli avrebbe detto «Sei uno zingaro».

Butic avrebbe cercato di spiegare che il festeggiamento era una dedica alla compagna incinta. Cosmi, sempre secondo la ricostruzione dei fatti, avrebbe risposto: «Che me ne frega della tua ragazza».

Sources indicate that la decisione è arrivata dopo gli accertamenti svolti dalla Procura Federale al termine della partita. L’arbitro, il primo assistente e il quarto ufficiale hanno dichiarato di non aver sentito le parole scambiate tra i due: si trovavano a circa venti metri di distanza. Un collaboratore della Procura Federale, che era invece a circa un metro da Cosmi e Butic, ha confermato di aver udito distintamente le parole denunciate dal calciatore del Bari.

Ascoltato durante le indagini, Cosmi non ha negato né il confronto con Butic né l’uso del termine contestato. Ha però sostenuto di aver pronunciato una frase diversa: «Ho detto a Butic: 'Non ti lamentare se poi ti chiamano zingaro'».

Il Giudice Sportivo non ha accolto questa versione. Ha ritenuto pienamente attendibili il racconto del calciatore e quello del collaboratore federale, qualificando l’espressione come discriminatoria per motivi di razza, nazionalità e origine etnica.

#50219. PSV back on top of Eredivisie as Feyenoord slump in Heerenveen

📅 09 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 3m • 📚 Deep Dive (571 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Dutchnews ↗ Open Full Page

PSV back on top of Eredivisie as Feyenoord slump in Heerenveen

📅 09 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (571 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dutchnews

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.
  • See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.
  • PSV returned to the top of the Eredivisie with a thumping 5-2 win over Cambuur Leeuwarden as previous leaders Feyenoord lost a seven-goal thriller against the other Frisian club, Heerenveen.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

PSV returned to the top of the Eredivisie with a thumping 5-2 win over Cambuur Leeuwarden as previous leaders Feyenoord lost a seven-goal thriller against the other Frisian club, Heerenveen.

It took just 46 seconds for PSV to get off the mark as Sven Mijnans headed in unmarked.

The midfielder added a second after 15 minutes and completed his hat-trick with a free-kick in the 80th minute to make the score 4-2, just as Cambuur were threatening a comeback.

Feyenoord’s dip in form continued as they let a two-goal lead slip at Heerenveen. The Rotterdammers looked to be in control going into the break with a trademark drilled shot by Anis Hadj Moussa and a penalty by Nacho Ferri.

But Maas Willemsen bundled in the ball from a corner on the stroke of half-time, before Ringo Meerveld came on for the second half and scored a hat-trick as Feyenoord’s defence crumbled under pressure.

It has been revealed that “In the matches when we played well I saw a team that fought for each other,” Feyenoord coach Giovanni van Bronckhorst stated after the game. “Mentally strong, kept running even when we didn’t have the ball. That’s our strength. When we don’t do that we’re a lesser team.”.

Mexx Meerdink scored a hotly contested late penalty to settle a tempestuous game in Alkmaar as AZ came back from 3-1 down against Groningen to claim their first win in five matches.

It has been revealed that goalkeeper Etienne Vaessen was given a second yellow card for protesting too hard against the decision to penalise him for upending Ayoub Oufkir. Once the commotion died down Meerdink, who had missed from the spot against Vaessen earlier in the second half, made no mistake against substitute goalkeeper Lovro Stubljar.

Ajax missed the chance to take over top spot at Twente as their former striker Wout Weghorst scored a last-minute penalty to rescue a point for the home side.

Ajax had been 2-0 up with a bullet header by their giant striker Tolu Arokodare and a long-range strike by Rayane Bounida, before an own goal by Dies Janse brought the visitors back into the game.

It has been revealed that fortuna Sittard also had to settle for a point against Telstar after going 2-0 up thanks to a bizarre own goal by Sem Valk. The defender’s sliced clearance looped over the head of Ronald Koeman Junior as the goalkeeper tried to head it away rather than risk being penalised for handling a backpass.

Goals just before half-time by Abdelnour Soualhia and Patrick Brouwer brought Telstar back into the game, but neither side was able to find a winner after the break.

That result allowed ADO, under the guidance of interim coach Levi Schwiebbe, to close the gap on 16th-placed Telstar to one point with a 3-1 win against Sparta, while bottom Willem II collected their third point of the season at home to PEC Zwolle.

ADO Den Haag 3-1 Sparta Rotterdam.

Cambuur Leeuwarden 2-5 PSV Eindhoven.

Treize ans après, Benoît Tremoulinas est toujours là, et, à l'âge de 40 ans, il va rechausser les crampons pour son club formateur, les Girondins de Bordeaux, qui survolent leur championnat de ....Régional .L'ex-défenseur international français (5 sélections) s'est parfaitement préparé dans le but de relever ce nouveau défi dans les meilleures conditions possibles. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Dopo aver respinto gli assalti estivi di Brentford, Parma e Fiorentina su richiesta di Gattuso, la dirigenza biancoceleste valuta il prolungamento oltre il 2027.

In a recent development, il futuro di Matteo Cancellieri alla Lazio continua ad attirare l'attenzione in vista dei prossimi mesi. Secondo quanto riportato da TuttoMercatoWeb, il club deve riflettere con attenzione sul contratto dell'esterno italiano, visto che l'accordo attuale scadrà il prossimo 30 giugno 2027.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sources indicate that nel corso dell'ultima sessione di mercato estiva, diversi club avevano provato a sondare il terreno per assicurarsi il giocatore. Dall'estero si era fatto avanti il Brentford dalla Premier League, mentre in Serie A avevano preso informazioni prima il Parma e poi la Fiorentina, specialmente dopo l'approdo nella Capitale di Albert Gudmundsson. Tuttavia, a bloccare ogni possibile partenza è stato lo stesso allenatore Gennaro Gattuso, fermamente intenzionato a non ridurre ulteriormente le opzioni a sua disposizione nel reparto offensivo.

Il tecnico punta forte su di lui anche per gennaio. Nonostante qualche guaio fisico, Cancellieri ha trovato spazio ed è stabilmente nelle rotazioni, alternandosi con un Isaksen in grande forma. Ora tocca al presidente Claudio Lotito e alla dirigenza decidere se avviare le trattative per il rinnovo.

#50210. Newcastle kit fiasco sums up haphazard pre-season

📅 15 Aug 2026 • ⏱️ 12m • 📚 Deep Dive (2467 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Newcastle kit fiasco sums up haphazard pre-season

📅 15 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 12 min read (2467 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~12 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Newcastle’s pre-season friendly against Bayer Leverkusen at St James’ Park took a bizarre turn when a kit clash prompted the hosts to change shirts midway through the first half.
  • The German team’s white away kit with blue trim proved hard to distinguish from Newcastle’s home strip, which has a white back and blue stripes across the shoulders.
  • During the first-half hydration break, Newcastle decided to change into their lilac third kit, which improved the viewing experience for fans who took to social media to question the original choice of kits.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Newcastle’s pre-season friendly against Bayer Leverkusen at St James’ Park took a bizarre turn when a kit clash prompted the hosts to change shirts midway through the first half.

The German team’s white away kit with blue trim proved hard to distinguish from Newcastle’s home strip, which has a white back and blue stripes across the shoulders.

During the first-half hydration break, Newcastle decided to change into their lilac third kit, which improved the viewing experience for fans who took to social media to question the original choice of kits.

Newcastle would go on to lose the game 2-1 in new manager Matthias Jaissle’s first game at St James’, a result which followed a 3-1 reverse against Everton on Wednesday evening.

Leverkusen, the 2023-24 Bundesliga champions now managed by Spaniard Carles Martínez Novell, scored after just 44 seconds through a powerful Ibrahim Maza strike.

Jaissle’s team found their feet as the first 45 minutes progressed, with Yoane Wissa their biggest attacking threat. The striker endured a difficult first season at the club, but his performances at the World Cup with DR Congo appear to have restored confidence.

In a recent development, newcastle were level just before half-time, when Malick Thiaw rose highest to plant home a back-post header from a corner. Former Brentford goalkeeper Mark Flekken appealed in vain for a foul, but there was no infringement.

After changing all 10 outfield players at half-time against Everton, Jaissle was more circumspect with second-half substitutes; Rory Finneran for Lewis Miley was the only change before the 80th minute.

Recent findings suggest that newcastle faded though, and the game was won by Victor Boniface scoring just a few minutes after coming on as a substitute. The Nigeria striker wrong-footed Sean Steur with an impudent piece of skill before rolling the ball into the bottom corner.

The North-East club are coming to terms with the departures of Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali and Bruno Guimarães this summer, as well as manager Eddie Howe. They have one more pre-season friendly to play, against Strasbourg on Sunday, before they begin their Premier League campaign at home to Liverpool.

Newcastle United (4-2-3-1) Hornicek; M Miley (Pivas 81), Thiaw, Botman, Hall; Steur, L Miley (Finneran h-t); Elanga, Woltemade (Neave 86), Barnes; Wissa. Subs Charlton, Harris (g), Sanusi, Johnson.

Bayer Leverkusen (4-2-3-1) Flekken; Vazquez (Tape h-t), Bade, Tapsoba, Gutierrez (Belocian 70); Garcia, Fernandez (Terrier 70); Maza (Boniface 80), Tillman (Doganay 70), Moreira (Tella 80); Kofane (Schick h-t). Subs Hofmann, Arthur, Oermann, Poku, Blaswich (g), Alfa-Ruprecht, Hawighorst, Lomb (g).

Referee Michael Oliver (Durham). Attendance 39,059.

A second pre-season defeat in a week for Newcastle. Just like against Everton, they faded in the second 45 minutes but Jaissle decided to leave some tired legs out there for fitness purposes. The performances of Barnes and Wissa were promising, but Newcaslte are giving up chances.

Newcastle had a free-kick with the last kick of the game, but Harvey Barnes loops the delivery straight into Flekken’s gloves.

Schik with a chance to wrap up the victory, but Hornicek saves before Thiaw clears to deny Terrier a tap in on the rebounds.

There will be just three minutes of added time to play.

Elanga fouled near the touchline, but time is running out. The free-kick won by Neave came to nothing.

Chance for Barnes! Good combination play involving Elanga and Wissa down the right, and the ball flashed across the six-yard box. Barnes almost steered it in, but did not make firm enough contact.

Newcastle attacking with more urgency since conceding, but there are moans and groans in the ground at a misplaced Elanga pass. Sean Neave has just replaced Woltemade, and the 19-year-old wins a free-kick in a crossing position with his first action of the game.

The striker has only been on the pitch a few minutes, but Boniface has restored Leverkusen’s lead. Lovely chop inside the box, which sent Steur for a hot dog, before passing the ball into the far corner. No celebration of note from a player who could be on the move this summer.

Newcastle making just their second change of the game: Pivas replaces Mason Miley at right-back.

Leverkusen have made two more changes: Moreira and Maza off, Tella and Boniface on.

The corner is straight down the throat of Flekken, and that prompsts some groans from the home fans.

Newcastle having to defend deep for long periods, but Elanga did well to win a free-kick with little support. Moreira dragged the winger down. Then Wissa’s cross is turned behind for a corner.

Sources indicate that woltemade’s control lets him down as he tries to bring the ball down on halfway. The game is being played at a snail’s pace at the moment, but Leverkusen are dominating the ball.

Play has now resumed. Garcia does well to defend after Lewis Hall won the ball back in a dangerous position.

Time for another hydration break and Leverkusen are making three more substitutions. We await further changes from Jaissle. Should the game finish level, there will be a penalty shoot-out to decide the winner of the Visit Malta Cup.

Rather like the mid-week friendly against Everton, Newcastle have faded after half-time. Struggling to get into the game in any meaningful way. Slick football from Leverkusen but Fernandez fails to bring the ball under his spell in the box when there was time and space to shoot.

Sources indicate that leverkusen just inches away from regaining the lead. It was an incisive run off the left from Afonso Moreira, who tried to place the ball into the far corner but his attempt rolled just wide of the post.

Good defensive header by Lewis Hall before Wissa wins a foul on halfway. Newcastle feeding off scraps at the moment. Elanga goes too early and is flagged offside.

In a recent development, bayer Leverkusen have had the better of it in this half, but some of the shooting has been wayward. This time is it Schik’s turn to slash a shot over the bar. Fouls committed by Finneran and Botman.

Industry observers note that newcastle with a three-on-three on the break after Wissa does well to win the ball back on halfway, but Woltemade was too slow to get his shot away at the end of the move. More good play from Wissa.

Half a chance for Fernandez to shoot from the edge of the D, but he was leaning back and ballooned the shot miles over the bar.

Recent findings suggest that finneran, the youngster in Newcastle’s midfield, is caught on the ball but then does well to recover it. I reckon there will be a raft of changes on the hour mark.

Corner for Leverkusen after Moreira gets forward and attacks Mason Miley. The German side have additional aerial threat with Schik on the pitch. Woltemade does well to head clear.

Bayer Leverkuen kick off in the second half.

Jaissle made 10 against Everton, so wants his starters to build minutes today. Rory Finneran is coming on for Newcastle, an 18-year-old academy player. He replaces Lewis Miley in midfield. Czech striker Patrik Schik is on for Bayer Leverkusen.

The scoreline is a fair reflection of an even first half, with Wissa Newcastle’s best player. The story though, is that kit clash that prompted Newcastle to change into their lilac third kit halfway through the half.

Just the two minutes of stoppage time to play.

It has been revealed that newcastle equalise from a set-piece. Flekken is claiming a foul, but it is a legitimate goal. The goalkeeper was nowhere to be seen on a corner that looped all the way to be back post, and he seemed to lose his bearings allowing Thiaw to find the far corner.

Newcastle have a corner after another move in which Wissa was lively. His performances have been a ray of light in pre-season, he really struggled in his first season at the club.

Lewis Hall takes the free-kick, but he scoops it well over the bar. Elanga delivers a low cross from the right, but Garcia is well positioned to clear.

Newcastle enjoying a lot more possession now, but you cannot say they look like equalising.

According to recent reports, that was better though, more zip in the attack with Elanga laying the ball off for Wissa and Fernandez is booked from dragging the Newcastle forward to the ground. Free-kick in a shooting position.

Sources indicate that good play from Lewis Hall, skipping beyond two challenges to escape from a tight spot but then his crossfield pass is intercepted. Moreira passes the ball straight out of play for a Newcastle goal kick, when there was a chance for Leverkusen to punish the hosts on the break.

It has been revealed that elanga tries to take on Gutierrez but his low cross is too close to Flekken. Gutierrez then buys a foul when under pressure from Lewis Miley. Game has become quite bitty following those stoppages. Maza then chops down Harvery Barnes.

The game is back under way. Changing kits has improved things visually but it is still not ideal. You wonder how on earth two clubs of this stature failed to liaise on this before the game.

In a recent development, bayer Leverkusen are still on top, but play has been stopped for a hydration break. Some boos from the stands, it is not an especially hot day.

On the subject of the kit clash, Newcastle are now changing into their lilac away kit. Shades of Manchester United at the Dell all those years ago.

A short stoppage in play after Tapsoba receives a knock in the small of the back from Newcastle’s goalkeeper Hornicek. Both managers get their players over for a tactical conflab.

Recent findings suggest that leverkusen look very accomplished in possession, they are moving the ball well through the lines. Kofane was a big threat when they played Arsenal in last season’s Champions League and they are looking to find him with crosses. Mason Miley defends well at right-back, but at the expense of a corner.

Flekken called into action again, Newcastle starting to warm to their task. It was direct play from first Elanga and then Barnes, but his cross deflects towards the goalkeeper and he parries away. Then Barnes is fouled, and Newcastle have a free-kick in a crossing position near the left corner of the penalty area. Poor delivery from Barnes, Flekken claims.

Recent findings suggest that newcastle fans sing “walking in a Keegan wonderland” in unison. Bade is then penalised for catching Woltemade late as they contested an aerial challenge.

Newcastle’s best moment so far: Wissa peels off the shoulder of Bade and tested Flekken with a volley from a tight angle. The goalkeeper saved and Leverkusen scramble clear, but it was good movement from the Newcastle striker.

Sources indicate that leverkusen continue to make the running, enjoying more possession and most of it is coming inside Newcastle’s half. Goalkeeper Flekken takes a beat inside his own six-yard box, and his pass out is almost cut out by Woltemade.

Newcastle’s players are wearing black armbands in memory of Kevin Keegan.

There is a slightly awkward clash of kits on display: both shirts feature a lot of white, and the blue trim around the shoulders of Newcastle’s home kit is quite similar to Leverkusen’s away strip.

Kofane, who impressed up front last season in Germany, throws himself at a cross.

Fans were barely settled in their seats when Maza’s vicious left-footed strike from outside of the area flew past Hornicek. Cracking goal, not much the goalkeeper could do about it.

Newcastle get the game under way.

Sources indicate that matthias Jaissle walks to the home dugout for the first time as manager. Just eight days until the proper stuff begins against Liverpool, a fixture which tends to throw up entertaining games. Bayer Leverkusen keep the home players waiting in the tunnel.

Recent findings suggest that the former Liverpool defender has been linked with a move to Arsenal this week. Quansah is with his team-mates but not part of the matchday squad.

Bayer Leverkusen XI: Flekken; Gutierrez, Bade, Fernandez, Moreira, Tillman, Tapsoba, Arthur, Garcia, Maza, Kofane.

Subs: Blaswich, Lomb, Hofmann, Terrier, Schick, Oermann, Tape, Poku, Vazquez, Boniface, Tella, Alfa-Ruprecht, Doganay, Hawighorst.

Newcastle XI: Hornicek; M Miley, Thiaw (c), Botman, Hall; Steur, L Miley; Elanga, Woltemade, Barnes; Wissa.

Subs: Harris, Charlton, Pivas, Sanusi, Johnson, Finneran, Neave.

Today's team to take on Bayer Leverkusen in the @VisitMalta Weekender 👊 pic.twitter.com/ZfRvucBXSq.

Newcastle United continue their preparations for the latest season with a home friendly against Bayer Leverkusen, hoping to improve on their pretty limp showing against Everton at Murrayfield.

Recent findings suggest that upcoming manager ​Matthias Jaissle is ‌refusing to dwell on the departure of key players that has left his club in turmoil going into the Premier League season, insisting that he sees opportunity in the situation. Jaissle was recruited from Saudi Pro League side Al-Ahli after Eddie Howe left last month, with the German coach joining a club who had lost Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali and captain Bruno Guimaraes in quick succession.

“It’s a challenge, a massive challenge, always when there’s a transitional period. ‌But it’s ‌not time to ⁠complain, it doesn’t make sense to see the negative things,” Jaissle noted.

“We want to see the chance in that situation and that’s our approach from day one. We are here to do our ⁠best job. We want to support the players, the current squad.

“There will be adjustments to see in the coming days, weeks. But for now it’s only focused on the daily work, the work we can influence. That’s all that ​matters now.”.

The 38-year-old coach arrived in Newcastle ‌having won two Austrian Bundesliga titles with Red Bull Salzburg before leading Al-Ahli to back-to-back AFC Champions League crowns.

He remained tight-lipped about new signings.

“Obviously, in that transition phase, the players who left the club were ‌great ​players, great characters, experienced ⁠players. This is now a vacuum,” he mentioned.

The most famous name in Dutch football could appear on an international men’s team sheet for the first time in 30 years after Johan Cruyff’s grandson was called up for the United States’ upcoming matches in Europe.

Shae Cruijff-Beane, the son of Johan Cruyff’s daughter Chantal and her American husband Todd Beane, was included in the squad that will play against Norway and Portugal in the next seven days.

In a recent development, cruijff-Beane plays as a midfielder for Gimnàstic de Tarragona, a club in the Spanish third tier based near Barcelona. His older brother Jordan also came through the club’s ranks and is presently playing US college football at Westmont College in California.

Shae, 17, is eligible to play for the USA through his father and Spain and the Netherlands through his mother, who spent part of her childhood in Catalonia while Johan Cruyff was playing for Barcelona in the 1970s.

The USA under-18 squad also includes an Ajax player, midfielder Xander Newstead, who grew up in San Francisco and joined the Amsterdam club’s youth team set-up at the age of 10, beforec signing professional terms last year.

Johan Cruyff went on to play in the United States for Los Angeles Aztecs and Washington Diplomats before returning to the Netherlands, winding down his career at Ajax and Feyenoord.

His son Jordi played for Barcelona and Manchester United and won nine international caps in 1996. Last year he was appointed technical director at Ajax, the club where his father began his career.

Il giornalista della Gazzetta dello Sport analizza il momento d'oro dei biancocelesti: dai meriti di Gattuso al confronto con le major.

Il noto giornalista della Gazzetta dello Sport Mimmo Cugini, intervenuto ai microfoni di TuttoMercatoWeb durante la trasmissione Maracanà, ha analizzato il momento straordinario della Serie A, concentrandosi in particolare sulle ambizioni e sul percorso di crescita della Lazio guidata da Gattuso.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Se facciamo una valutazione tecnica, nelle seconde scelte c'è un gap con le squadre che lottano per il titolo. Bisogna però valutare come gioca questa Lazio, perché Gattuso è riuscito a far dare ai giocatori tutto ciò che hanno e anche qualcosa in più. L'esempio più lampante è quello di Frattesi, che all'Inter era in un sistema di gioco che non lo valorizzava nonostante i gol pesanti segnati in Champions League. I giocatori della Lazio fanno quello che sanno fare e quindi ad ora viaggiano.

Lo scudetto è una grande scommessa e illusione, ma capisco l'entusiasmo dei tifosi, perché una stagione in cui le altre non danno il cento per cento può capitare. Ad ora non vedo troppe squadre che possono metterla in difficoltà, ma sicuramente capiremo di più quando avrà affrontato Roma, Inter e Como. In questo momento sono sulle ali dell'entusiasmo.

Sutalo rischia almeno due mesi di stop; per Tavares, Gattuso prepara Pedraza sulla corsia sinistra.

Secondo quanto riportato da TUTTOmercatoWEB, Gennaro Gattuso deve modificare l'assetto anche per lo stop di Tavares: sulla sinistra il posto dell'ex Arsenal sarà preso da Pedraza.

Recent findings suggest that L'assenza del difensore pesa sulle scelte per il Lecce. Gattuso ha però mostrato piena fiducia nel portoghese e si prepara ad affidargli il posto di Sutalo.

Dutch progress in Nations League despite 5-0 drubbing in Germany

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (384 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Dutchnews

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways

  • See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

The Netherlands came crashing down to earth after hammering Greece as they were outclassed and outmuscled by Germany in Berlin.

Oranje went into the final match of the Nations League group stage with high hopes of recording their first win over their old rivals in seven matches stretching back to 2019.

Instead they suffered their second worst defeat ever at the hands of Germany, but still progressed to the knockout stages thanks to their thumping 7-0 win in Amsterdam on Friday.

Coach Xavi Hernandez was forced to make one change in midfield as Jurriën Timber replaced Barcelona’s Frenkie de Jong, who pulled out with an obturator muscle strain.

Germany shaded the first half and went ahead five minutes before the break when Freiburg striker Derry Scherhant cut in from the left hand side and beat Bart Verbruggen with a curling strike into the top corner.

Scherhant had struck the post minutes earlier, while the Dutch might have taken the lead earlier when Crysencio Summerville slipped in the penalty area as he tried to control a cross by Cody Gakpo.

According to recent reports, but in the second half the Dutch fell apart. In the 60th minute Florian Wirtz shoved Denzel Dumfries off the ball and had space to tee up a left-footed shot from the edge of the area that gave Verbruggen no chance.

Nico Schlotterbeck added a third from a free-kick five minutes later, before Wirtz drifted past Gakpo on the right side of the penalty area to score his second.

The humiliation was complete when Brajan Gruda capped a fine attacking performance by firing in a rebound.

Sources indicate that dumfries made no excuses afterwards for what he admitted was a “terrible performance”. “We gave the ball away too easily, left too much space and were too weak in the challenges,” he told NOS. “We can’t let that happen.”.

Champion de France U17 en 2013 aux côtés de Léo Pétrot, Jonathan Bamba, Allan Saint-Maximin & co sous la houlette de l'excellent duo Gilles Rodriguez - Lionel Vaillant, Cazim Sujic n'avait plus trouvé le chemin des filets depuis 3 ans et demi et son joli mais vain coup franc victorieux avec Piacenza contre Vicenza en Série C (L3 italienne).

Rashford returns and Fernandes misses another penalty as Man Utd humbled by Amorim

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Bruno Fernandes missed a penalty for the second successive pre-season friendly as Manchester United were beaten 4-2 by former head coach Ruben Amorim’s AC Milan.
  • Fernandes, who rolled a spot-kick wide in a shoot-out against Leeds in midweek, was gifted the chance to open his pre-season account in Wroclaw, Poland.
  • His effort was on target this time, but Milan keeper Lorenzo Torriani dived to his right to beat the shot away.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Bruno Fernandes missed a penalty for the second successive pre-season friendly as Manchester United were beaten 4-2 by former head coach Ruben Amorim’s AC Milan.

Fernandes, who rolled a spot-kick wide in a shoot-out against Leeds in midweek, was gifted the chance to open his pre-season account in Wroclaw, Poland.

His effort was on target this time, but Milan keeper Lorenzo Torriani dived to his right to beat the shot away.

Fernandes did at least get an assist, taking the second-minute corner which was powerfully headed home by Harry Maguire to give United the lead.

Amorim’s Milan equalised after a defensive mix-up allowed Gonçalo Ramos to break into the area and square for Samuel Chukwueze to roll home.

United were awarded their penalty just before half-time after Koni De Winter tugged back Youri Tielemans, but Torriani guessed correctly to leave Fernandes frustrated.

United retook the lead after Patrick Dorgu pounced on a loose backpass from Filippo Terracciano, but Milan equalised again when Chukwueze’s wayward shot was poked in by Alphadjo Cissè at the far post.

Marcus Rashford, who was frozen out by Amorim and loaned out to Aston Villa and then Barcelona, came on as a substitute on the hour for his first United appearance since returning from Spain.

But Milan went ahead in the 68th minute when Chukwueze’s cross was headed home by Ramos, and three minutes later former Chelsea midfielder Ruben Loftus-Cheek raced through to hit the fourth and cap a performance that underlines United’s need for reinforcements before their season starts in earnest next Saturday, away at Hull City.

Sources indicate that manchester United (4-2-3-1) Lammens; Mazraoui (Dalot 61), Maguire, Heaven (Martinez 61), Shaw; Tielemans, Santos (Mainoo 61); Diallo (Lacey 61), Fernandes, Dorgu (Rashford 61); Cunha (Mbeumo 61). Subs Zirkzee, Yoro, J Fletcher, T Fletcher, Amass, Collyer, Mee (g), Heath (g), Gabriel. Booked Dorgu.

AC Milan (3-4-2-1) Torriani; Terracciano (Gila 60), Winter (Vladimirov 84), Pavlovic (Diawara 84); Chukwueze, Musah (Ricci 76), Jashari (Modric 60), Estupinan (Bartesaghi 61); Loftus-Cheek (Comotto 84), Cisse (Saelemaekers 60); Ramos (Camarda 75). Subs Pittarella (g), Bouyer (g). Booked Estupinan.

Goals Chukwueze (37), Cisse (57), Ramos (68), Loftus-Cheek (71).

That six-time Champions League winner Luka Modric raised the trophy with the one hand noted everything you need to know about this moment...

It has been revealed that united’s pre-season ends in defeat. A wretched second half proves their undoing as Amorim’s Milan score four. Worth reminding that United led this match, twice.

Milan are playing keep-ball in these latter stages and although Mainoo regains possession, his attempt to play forward is cut out and Modric’s outside-of-the-foot pass finds Comotto, who heads straight at Lammens.

Four minutes of added time to be played...

United now raining crosses down on Milan’s box but Torriani equal to it every time.

For the second time this afternoon, Shaw directs a lovely ball into Fernandes’ path in behind Milan’s back line, but the Portugal international can’t bring it under his spell.

Sources indicate that martinez has added a little bit of urgency to United’s build-up. Mbeumo tries to feed Shaw down the line but the ball is cut out.

Sources indicate that more substitutions... Diawara, Vladimirov and Comotto enter the field of play in place of Pavlovic, De Winter and Loftus-Cheek.

In a recent development, massive chance for Rashford! Martinez lofts a fantastic ball over the top but Rashford is not quite able to bring it under his spell, with Torriani and De Winter combing to clear their lines.

Milan are now sitting off, settling into a back five as they look to preserve their advantage. Fernandes, Tielemans and Dalot combine well but such has been United’s fortunes this afternoon, the ball ricochets off the referee and play is halted.

Good work from Rashford in the corner to regain possession, but his ball into the box is not picked up by a team-mate.

Sources indicate that more changes... Ramos and Musah make way for Camarda and Ricci.

According to recent reports, manchester United 2 AC Milan 4 (Loftus-Cheek) No sooner had the players returned after the second-half hydration break then Milan exploit United’s exposed left side (again). Ramos sends Loftus-Cheek through and the midfielder composes himself before bending the ball around Lammens.

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 3 (Ramos) That’s too easy. United fail to learn their lesson, Shaw not getting tight enough to Chukwueze and the winger’s cross is met by newly introduced signing Ramos, who powers a header back across goal and past Lammens.

Loftus-Cheek and Ramos are doing a good job of cutting off the pass into United’s midfield in their build-up phase.

Wholesale changes on the hour mark...

Rashford (who makes his first United appearance in almost two years), Lacey, Dalot, Mbeumo, Mainoo and Martinez replace Dorgu, Amad, Mazraoui, Cunha, Santos and Heaven.

For Milan, Saelemaekers, Bartesaghi, Gila and Modric are on for Cisse, Estupinan, Terracciano and Jashari.

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 2 (Cisse) United have set a higher defensive line so far this half, with their front line pressing with more intensity to avoid the ball over the top. However Chukwueze is able to find space around the sides, coming in off the right and curling an effort goalwards which Cisse turns in at the far post. There are calls for offside, but with no VAR here, the goal stands.

Sources indicate that milan win a free-kick some 25 yards out after Fernandes clips Estupinan. Teenager Cisse steps up and fires straight into the United wall. Was always going to be difficult to trouble Lammens from there.

In a recent development, manchester United 2 AC Milan 1 (Dorgu) United wisely decide to keep hold of the ball for a while, the midfield three rotating to disrupt Milan’s out-of-possession shape and open up passing lanes. A Milan throw-in from the right-back berth is precedes an awful backpass by Terracciano which is pounced on by Dorgu who curls the ball beyond Torriani.

Industry observers note that united have looked bright in the opening moments of this half. They win a free-kick midway into Milan’s half. The ball is delivered to the back post and, after some 18-yard-box pinball, a relieved Torriano pounces on it.

Both teams remain unchanged as the second 45 minutes begin.

Sources indicate that all square at the break. Tough to know what to make of that half – United looked solid enough and could have taken a lead into the interval had Fernandes converted his penalty, but they failed to create a wealth of clear-cut chances. It will be interesting to see how Carrick approaches this second half.

Milan have enjoyed just a tick over two-thirds of possession, which United have contributed to in part through some lackadaisical passing.

It has been revealed that fernandes misses a spot-kick for the second time in two friendlies! Here, Torriani guesses correctly, diving to his right to palm Fernandes’ strike away.

De Winter brings down Tielemans inside the box after Terracciano loses the ball attempting to play out from the back.

Manchester United 1 AC Milan 1 (Chukwueze) It’s all a bit messy. Jashari causes Maguire and Santos to crash into each other (Kaka at Old Trafford, anyone?) off a throw-in, Ramos taking over with the United pair out of commission. He finds Chukwueze who finishes the move off at the far post.

The match becomes stretched momentarily as Pavlovic, the centre-back, marauds forward, setting the ball to Estupinan who delivers another dangerous cross from the left, which Lammens does well to claim.

It has been revealed that santos clips Loftus-Cheek near the byline and the referee awards Milan a free-kick. Chukwueze cuts the ball back to an unmarked Jashari on the edge of the box, but his side-footed effort flies wide.

Milan supporters unfurl a banner paying tribute to the late, great Franco Baresi, who passed away on July 31 aged 66.

United have picked their moments to press. Santos, who has enjoyed a wonderful pre-season, is a little too overzealous in his attempts to regain possession and gives away a foul. But the intent is correct.

Shaw floats a delightful ball over the top for Fernandes to gallop on to. The Portuguese steals in ahead of De Winter but cannot find the target with his weaker left foot.

Cisse escapes the clutches of Mazraoui down the left and fires a shot (more likely a mis-hit cross) straight into the gloves of Lammens.

United finally get their foot on the ball, but Heaven attempts an ambitious cross-field pass and possession goes back to the Italians.

According to recent reports, A Mexican wave has already begun. We’re only 21 minutes in...

It has been revealed that carrick’s side continue to sit off, allowing Milan to keep hold of the ball. Cisse works in from the left, playing a neat one-two with Ramos before his curled strike sails well over.

Sources indicate that A period of extended possession for Milan, United dropping into a compact 4-4-2 mid-block. Estupinan rains in a dangerous cross from the left and the ball falls to Loftus-Cheek, whose effort is expertly saved by the right boot of Lammens.

Estupinan goes into the book after pulling Amad’s shirt as he looked to dart in behind after Tielemans had played a dangerous through-ball. Might possibly have been the last man?

Tielemans cedes possession to the busy Jashari just outside his own box, the Swiss midfielder moving the ball on to Loftus-Cheek who fires a shot straight at Lammens.

Amad picks Pavlovic’s pocket and the Milan centre-half is forced to concede a corner. United unable to score from this one.

Recent findings suggest that milan are indeed in Amorim’s preferred 3-4-2-1 formation. They circulate the ball in front of United’s first line of pressure in an attempt to calm things down.

Manchester United 1 AC Milan 0 (Maguire) Fernandes delivers an inswinger from the left and Maguire is there to meet it at the back post, striding past Musa to plant a header past Torriani.

United make a fast start, Dorgu flashing a cross-cum-shot across the face of goal. Torriani gets a fingertip to it and thte ball goes behind for a corner.

Sources indicate that szymon Marciniak, the experienced Polish referee, gets us under way. Milan send the ball back to goalkeeper Torriani.

In a recent development, the players emerge from the tunnel, United debuting their lovely new cream third kit and Milan in their traditional red-and-black home colours. Smoke machines and pyrotechnics add to the atmosphere in Wroclaw...

We are almost ready to go. Let us know your match predictions and thoughts on United’s prospects this season in the comments section beneath this blog.

Manchester United defeated Leeds United on penalties to hoist the mighty Boyle Sports Cup at Croke Park. The match, a 1-1 draw, was brought to an abrupt end after five young pitch invaders ran to the middle of the field to take selfies with Bruno Fernandes. In the shoot-out it was James Justin who missed the “decisive” spot-kick, paving the way for Noussair Mazraoui to win it for United.

Marcus Rashford is on the bench this afternoon and could make his first United appearance since his cameo in a Europa League win over Viktoria Plzen in December 2024. He was frozen out under Amorim and has since been loaned to Aston Villa and Barcelona, but his Old Trafford future under Carrick remains unclear.

Michael Carrick believes Manchester United can push for the Premier League title, but has underlined the urgent need for signings.

The United head coach has taken heart from his squad’s promising preparations for the new campaign and, speaking at their Co Kildare summer base, he explained why he was confident they could build on last season’s third-place finish.

Carrick has been thrilled to hear United’s players discussing what they might achieve and has dared supporters to dream that they can get closer to last year’s champions Arsenal. But he is also a realist and recognises he is not blessed with options.

So far United have added Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos and Karl Darlow, a reserve goalkeeper, but their £83.3m spend is significantly less than what newly promoted clubs Ipswich Town (£109.4m) and Coventry City (£92.2m) have invested in their squads.

Amorim’s side have gone intercontinental this summer, travelling from Scotland to Indonesia, via Australia, before arriving in Poland for the last of their four pre-season games.

At his AC Milan unveiling, Amorim was asked about the learnings from his United tenure that he would take into his newly introduced role. He mentioned: “The first thing is it’s hard to explain the mistakes because for that I would have to explain the context of the last adventure.

In a recent development, “It’s hard to say to you every mistake. The only thing I can say is that I learned a lot and I made some mistakes.

“I didn’t have the opportunity, and I’m sorry for that, I didn’t have the opportunity to say something to the Manchester United fans at the moment and I’m really proud to be their coach for a year in that time.

“But now it’s a different history. There are a lot of things that I could do better in the last experience but sometimes it’s like that, you need to learn to find the right spot to reach a different level and that’s my thinking here.

“Everyone learns from their experience. I learned a lot, I did some mistakes I will try to change, there are some thing you will never change but I think I will be a better manager, that’s all.”.

Recent findings suggest that welcome to live coverage of Manchester United’s final pre-season match, against AC Milan in Wroclaw, Poland. Michael Carrick’s side will look to apply the finishing touches to a promising summer on the pitch, which has included victories over Rosenborg and Atlético Madrid, plus a draw against European champions Paris St-Germain. The team will fly back to Manchester with the big ones, the ones they have always wanted – the Snapdragon Cup and the Boyle Sports Cup – in tow.

In a recent development, at the Tarczynski Stadium there will be a reunion with former manager Ruben Amorim, who was appointed AC Milan’s head coach in June, five months after being sacked by United. Following a frustrating season under Massimiliano Allegri in which Milan fell out of the Champions League spots on the final day, the Rossoneri said Amorim would bring a “modern dominant tactical approach”. His methods failed to cut through at Old Trafford, though, during a tumultuous 14-month reign which finally ended after the Portuguese “blew up” during a heated meeting with director of football Jason Wilcox. At Milan, Amorim has persisted with the 3-4-2-1 formation that was doomed at United.

Industry observers note that carrick made clear this week that United must strengthen if they are to challenge for titles. So far the club have brought in Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos and Karl Darlow, but they are still in the market for a left-back and another midfielder. The future of Marcus Rashford has also been a topic of conversation among United fans. The forward has not played for his boyhood club since December 2024 but has joined up with his team-mates in Poland and it remains to be seen if he features in Carrick’s forward planning.

Kobbie Mainoo, who did not play a minute at this summer’s World Cup, and Lisandro Martínez have also joined up with the team this week and could be handed their first minutes of pre-season having been named in the matchday squad. For Milan, fresh signing Gonçalo Ramos – bought from PSG for £63m – will make his first appearance in the famous red and black.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that comme l'avait fait l'avant-veille La Dernière Heure Les Sports +, la RTBF a abordé hier la course à la succession du néo-retraité international Romelu Lukaku. Extraits.

Industry observers note that "Le style d’attaquant ultra-puissant, fort dos au but, dangereux de la tête, redoutable finisseur va désormais manquer en équipe nationale. On se penche vers nos jeunes promesses pour tenter de retrouver ce type de buteur qui pèse sur une défense et qui nous a souvent sortis d’une impasse ces dernières années. Chez les moins de 21 ans, les perspectives restent prometteuses pour occuper ce rôle de pur n°9 : trois buteurs déjà bien connus se disputent deux places dans le onze de base de Gill Swerts : Lucas Stassin, Roméo Vermant et Norman Bassette. Robin Mirisola (OHL, prêté par Genk) reste une alternative à garder à l’œil, lui qui a inscrit récemment deux buts contre l’Italie en amical.

Quatre jeunes buteurs au profil intéressant… mais différent de celui de Romelu Lukaku dont la puissance pouvait faire valser dans le décor n’importe quel défenseur une fois lancé vers le but. Stassin et Vermant ont été convoqués une seule fois par Rudi Garcia. Bassette, lui, a été appelé une fois sous l’ère Domenico Tedesco. A titre de comparaison, lorsqu’il avait 21 ans, Substantial Rom comptait déjà 11 buts avec les Diables Rouges. Preuve une nouvelle fois de sa précocité et de son efficacité inédite sous la vareuse noire-jaune-rouge. Les souliers laissés par Romelu sont sans doute encore un peu trop grands pour ces trois-là.

Dans les catégories d’âge inférieures, un joueur a crevé l’écran ces derniers mois : Jeoffrey Mbambi. Tout juste âgé de 15 ans, le Belge est en train d’affoler les compteurs. En 5 rencontres, l’avant-centre a trouvé 9 fois le fond des filets (dont quatre doublés) pour les U17 où il est surclassé. En 364 minutes jouées, soit un but toutes les 40 minutes en moyenne ! Puissant, rapide, un sens du but déjà aiguisé, les similitudes sur le terrain entre Mbambi et Lukaku sont frappantes. Physiquement aussi, le Diablotin mesure déjà 1m86.

Des ressemblances aussi dans le parcours et les origines. Né à Vilvorde, Jeoffrey grandit dans une famille de footeux. Le Belgo-Congolais est le frère cadet de Jérémy Mbambi (18 ans), qui évolue à Saint-Trond, et Jediaél Mbambi (17 ans), son autre frère, qui a signé son premier contrat professionnel à Saint-Etienne [ce dernier n'a joué cette saison qu'un seul match de N2 - lors de la 1ère journée - et 3 avec les U19 nationaux, le dernier il y a 2 mois pile poil, ndp2] . Cet été, repéré par le Club Bruges, Jeoffrey Mbambi a paraphé son premier contrat pro en Venise du Nord, le liant aux Blauw & Zwart jusqu’en 2029.

According to recent reports, dans le noyau des U18, l’adaptation s’est bien déroulée puisque le Brabançon a disputé 8 rencontres et planté 7 buts. Des débuts plus que prometteurs à 15 ans, faut-il encore le rappeler, qui lui permettent de s’entraîner de temps à autre avec le Club NXT, les U23 évoluant en Challenger Pro League. Jeoffrey Mbambi ne devrait pas tarder avant de faire ses débuts dans le football professionnel belge. Certaines rumeurs l’envoient déjà dans les plus grands clubs européens à l’affût.".

Il Profeta ricorda il suo sogno di vincere a Roma ed elogia Gattuso, Zaccagni e Frattesi nella squadra capolista.

Hernanes assegna alla Lazio il 15% di possibilità di vincere lo scudetto, pur considerando l’Inter la squadra più forte. Secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, L’ex centrocampista, soprannominato «Profeta», si dice emozionato nel vedere i biancocelesti primi in classifica e riconosce nella squadra la mentalità di Gattuso.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Per descriverla, Hernanes sceglie un vino che produce in Piemonte: «La Lazio di Gattuso è come un Grignolino, un rosso che produco sulle colline di Asti e di Monferrato, in Piemonte. Un vino romantico. Quando lo bevi, ti viene da sorridere. E mi capita di farlo ogni volta che guardo questa Lazio, prima in classifica con pieno merito». Produce vino da una decina d’anni e nelle Langhe ha il suo campo base, chiamato «Ca’ del profeta».

Il primato ha sorpreso anche lui: «Non me l’aspettavo, ma s’è creata una bella magia». Alla domanda sul titolo richiama l’impresa del Leicester in Premier League, poi dà una percentuale: «Io dico che la Lazio ha il 15% di portare a casa il campionato. Anche se la più forte resta sempre l’Inter».

Sources indicate that hernanes distingue l’emozione dal tifo: è affezionato anche agli altri club in cui ha giocato, ma ricorda che, al suo arrivo a Roma, dichiarò di voler vincere il campionato. Gli risposero che la Lazio lottava per l’Europa; lui, racconta, combatté quella mentalità. «Sognavo di vincere e di lottare per lo scudetto. Vederla lassù mi emoziona».

According to recent reports, nella squadra Hernanes rivede il carattere dell’allenatore: «Questa Lazio gli somiglia: è come se in campo ci fossero undici Rino. È riuscito a trasmettere la sua mentalità alla squadra. La voglia di azzannare ogni caviglia, lottare su ogni pallone, dare tutto senza risparmiarsi mai. Vedo la sua fame, la sua voglia». Da avversario affrontò Gattuso due volte e dice di averlo sempre stimato per l’onestà e il rispetto con cui giocava.

Recent findings suggest that tra i biancocelesti cita Zaccagni, che secondo i dati da lui studiati crea più occasioni di chiunque altro, e poi Mandas, Belahyane, Provstgaard, Floriani Mussolini e Frattesi. È soprattutto Frattesi, a suo giudizio, a rispecchiare il calcio di Gattuso: nella corsa fatta contro il Napoli prima del gol Hernanes vede ciò che serve per sognare lo scudetto. A Taylor, ribattezzato «profeta», riconosce intelligenza tattica, senso del gol e qualità tecniche. Considera inoltre l’infortunio di Nuno Tavares un duro colpo: per caratteristiche fisiche e stile di gioco lo ritiene insostituibile.

Hernanes non crede che i tifosi tornerebbero allo stadio se a marzo la Lazio fosse ancora in quella posizione. Cita la scaramanzia e il rapporto con il presidente, augurandosi che la situazione si risolva perché la squadra merita uno stadio pieno.

Tra i ricordi biancocelesti sceglie i gol nei derby, la Coppa Italia del 26 maggio e le punizioni segnate con entrambi i piedi. Soprattutto, però, gli è rimasta una frase rivoltagli da un tifoso: «non te ne annà, profe’…». Racconta che, dopo quel pomeriggio a Formello, ricevette circa diecimila messaggi dai laziali e cercò di rispondere a tutti. Per lo scudetto indica ancora l’Inter come favorita e invita a fare attenzione anche alla Roma. Di Nico Paz dice che è più forte di lui: «Un fenomeno».

Provstgaard e Isaksen hanno giocato entrambi tutti i 99 minuti con la Danimarca. Il difensore ha retto l’urto, mentre Isaksen ha servito un assist. In Nations League, però, i danesi si sono fatti rimontare dalla Norvegia.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that cela faisait 25 jours que Laurent Peyrelade avait été limogé par la Direction du SEC Bastia.
  • "L'arrivée de Ghislain Printant ne doit donc rien à l'improvisation, encore moins à la précipitation.
  • It has been revealed that le quotidien précise : "Certes, le club a changé depuis son passage entre 2010 et 2016, époque durant laquelle il a connu Gilles Cioni, l'actuel coordinateur sportif du Sporting.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that cela faisait 25 jours que Laurent Peyrelade avait été limogé par la Direction du SEC Bastia. Les dirigeants du club corse ont pris leur temps mais, surtout, ont voulu se donner le maximum de réflexion. Plusieurs noms ont circulé avant l'officialisation du nouveau coach qui sera Ghislain Printant, ainsi que l'indique Corse-Matin. Le SEC Bastia n'a pas tardé a apporter la confirmation. Dans le même communiqué, le club indique, tout en le remerciant, que Michel Moretti reste à son poste d'adjoint.

"L'arrivée de Ghislain Printant ne doit donc rien à l'improvisation, encore moins à la précipitation. Le coach qui a fait monter le Sporting à Paris pour la finale de la Coupe de la Ligue, en avril 2015, a toujours clamé son amour du club, y compris lorsqu'il a été démis de ses fonctions en janvier 2016 au profit de son adjoint d'alors, François Ciccolini.Loyal, certes, mais aussi compétent puisqu'au-delà de ses premières fonctions de formateur, il a longtemps été un entraîneur adjoint, à Montpellier, bien sûr, mais aussi à Marseille, à Saint-Etienne, avec la sélection de Côte d'Ivoire, toujours avec son ami de longue date, le regretté Jean-Louis Gasset.".

It has been revealed that le quotidien précise : "Certes, le club a changé depuis son passage entre 2010 et 2016, époque durant laquelle il a connu Gilles Cioni, l'actuel coordinateur sportif du Sporting. Pour autant, lors d'un récent entretien avec notre titre, il avait démontré qu'il suivait toujours l'actualité du club, d'autant que son fils, Florian, y était entraîneur des gardiens avant de s'engager avec Evian-Thonon.Le nouveau coach du Sporting devrait bien évidemment être dans les travées d'Armand-Cesari pour le match face à Villefranche, ce samedi 21 octobre. Lundi il devrait diriger sa première séance et tenir une conférence de presse de présentation.".

Sources indicate that ghislain Printant était arrivé à l'ASSE en décembre 2017, comme adjoint de  Jean-Louis Gasset. Le duo succédait à Oscar Garcia, Julien Sablé ayant assuré un interim de 35 jours. Après une belle fin de saison 2017-2018, et une non moins belle saison 2018-2019, ponctuée par une 4ème place qualificative pour l'Europa League, il a été nommé entraîneur principal de l'ASSE, le 6 juin 2019, suite au départ de Jean-Louis Gasset. Mais le début de saison 2019-2020 est mitigé et son contrat sera résilié le 4 octobre 2019, laissant la place à Claude Puel.

Quelques mois plus tard, le 10 août 2020, Ghislain Printant va rejoindre son ami Jean-Louis Gasset et devenir son adjoint aux Girondins de Bordeaux.

L'ASNL revient à hauteur des leaders stéphanois, qui gardent une meillleure différence de buts (+14 contre +9) avant d'aller à Reims demain soir.

Au stade Bauer, le Red Star de Dylan Durivaux (titulaire et capitaine) a battu sur le fil (2-1) le Pau FC. A l'instar de Brice Maubleu et Cheikh Fall, Axel Dodote était titulaire en l'absence d'Anthony Briançon. Mais le défenseur international U20 a été remplacé dès la 54e minute sous les yeux de l'autre joueur prêté par l'ASSE aux Béarnais, Luan Gadegbeku, resté encore sur le banc...

According to recent reports, sans Kilyan Jusseron-Venière, le FC Annecy a battu 4-2 le Clermont Foot de Stéphane Tessier et David Guion. Grâce à son numéro 42 (le Colombien Cristian Castro), le FC Metz a gagné 2-1 ce soir à Saint-Symphorien face à l'USBCO des supporters stéphanois Fabien Dagneaux (entraîneur) et Antoine Decaix (préparateur physique).

#50180. Breaking: Arsenal hunger is ominous for rivals as they dismantle Man City

Breaking: Arsenal hunger is ominous for rivals as they dismantle Man City

📅 16 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 30 min read (5988 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~30 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Was it the early goal that should have put Arsenal’s rivals on red alert?
  • How about the emphatic scoreline – surely that was it?
  • So what was it that should have those with pretensions of ripping Arsenal’s crown from their grasp shuffling uncomfortably?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Was it the early goal that should have put Arsenal’s rivals on red alert? No. While Ricardo Calafiori’s intervention was dramatic, it wasn’t that. Was it the seamless introduction of the newly introduced signings, then? No, it wasn’t that either, despite the excellence of Bruno Guimarães and Christos Tzolis.

How about the emphatic scoreline – surely that was it? Again, the answer is no. Three unanswered goals against Manchester City will always grab a headline, but scorelines do not always define the nature of a performance or a team’s capabilities.

So what was it that should have those with pretensions of ripping Arsenal’s crown from their grasp shuffling uncomfortably? One word: hunger. The reason this was such an ominous afternoon for the chasing pack is the fact Mikel Arteta’s team played with intensity of a team with everything to prove.

Title wins can sometimes sate ambition. Players don’t always want to climb the same mountain again, not least if reaching the peak was initially so draining, but everywhere you looked on a day when Cardiff was painted red and white was evidence that Arsenal remain ravenous for success.

According to recent reports, first Guimarães pounced out of the shadows to mug Jérémy Doku, leaving him in a heap. Then there was Gabriel Magalhães thundering into a befuddled Doku, celebrating in front of City’s fans as if he had scored, before Ben White flung himself in front of the Belgian, denying a clear-cut scoring opportunity.

Ben White to the rescue with an incredible block 🦸📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ZK0cNnFz5N.

Another notable incident was Martin Odegaard, not long after he had glossed a fabulous display with a third goal, sprinting 30 yards to spook Gianluigi Donnarumma and make the Italian hurry his clearance. The victory was good, the trophy was nice, but the energy heartened Arteta more than anything.

Recent findings suggest that “They are really good examples,” Arteta remarked. “The way the team tracks back is unbelievable, especially when, fitness-wise, we aren’t there yet. We had desire and composure on the ball. When you put your soul and your heart into every action, this is what happens. We want to do it again.

“The desire comes from them thinking: ‘I want to live that moment again. I want to have all the moments again and I want them to be even bigger.’ We know what it is going to take. We have never done it [retain the Premier League] at this football club. We know it will demand something special.”.

According to recent reports, you could flip that and say it will take something special from the chasers. George Graham and Arsène Wenger could never hold on to the biggest prize during their reigns and you must return to Herbert Chapman, in Arsenal’s thriving 1930s, to find the only manager who went back-to-back.

In a recent development, it can feel premature (and can be foolish) to go out on a limb before the first weekend, but there was just something about them that felt different. Often in the past they have been overtly tentative when playing City, but they came out of their corner this time swinging – and they landed.

Enzo Maresca revealed afterwards that he “really didn’t like” how Arsenal had scored their first goal and that was putting it mildly, as there were 10 passes – broken only by the ball bouncing off Elliott Anderson’s shins – before Myles Lewis-Skelly ushered Calafiori into wreak havoc.

You had to go back to 1968, when City played West Brom, to find the last first-minute goal – City’s Bobby Owen was the scorer that day – and how Calafiori enjoyed it, shaking his fist in delight as Arsenal’s noisy fans reminded everyone of their status.

Riccardo Calafiori gives Arsenal the lead after just 24 seconds 🤯The assist from Myles Lewis-Skelly 👏📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/aU0UsCB1Xs.

According to recent reports, here was a rude awakening for Anderson, City’s upcoming £116m man. He was ever so slightly off the pace and that allowed Lewis-Skelly to slip a beautiful ball in behind the FA Cup winners’ defence and invite Calafiori to do the rest, which he did with assurance.

In a recent development, when Maresca watches back the video, he will see Abdukodir Khusanov sleeping and Phil Foden failing to press, but that should not detract from the quality of Arsenal’s interchanging – and it should also make whoever is hawking Lewis-Skelly around to clubs to think again. Why would he leave this?

Industry observers note that it should not have been the case that a goal so soon should have governed how the game progressed, but that is exactly what happened as Arsenal completely dominated. Whenever they lost possession, they recovered it as a matter of urgency. Without Pep Guardiola on the touchline, City were like Samson after Delilah shaved his hair, devoid of all power.

City, in contrast to their opponents, showed a complete lack of desire and the second goal arrived when Odegaard was allowed time to flip a ball to the back post, where new boy Tzolis was arriving. The Greek headed back into the six-yard area and Kai Havertz did the rest.

Kai Havertz finishes off a well-worked move to double Arsenal's lead 🤩📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/tGkxCIBV8F.

Arsenal were criticised – fairly – during their title-winning campaign for being too physical and relying on gamesmanship, but if Havertz and Odegaard can stay fit for a prolonged period, the difference in style will be like night and day.

Throw in Tzolis, who was tricky and dynamic in Cardiff, to the mix and there will be another enhancement. He looks considerably better than Gabriel Martinelli, with more end product, and Bukayo Saka will do more down the right than Noni Madueke, who started here.

Maresca knew, with his team lacking fitness, that it would be difficult to overhaul the deficit once they had gone two goals behind but, really, he was lucky that Arsenal did not administer a genuine hiding which, at one stage, seemed as though they might.

Goal number three arrived just after the interval, again Lewis-Skelly and Tzolis were involved, combining to enable Odegaard to waltz into the area, hoodwinking Donnarumma so he sat down before sliding a contemptuous finish beyond him.

Take a bow, Martin Ødegaard 😮‍💨Arsenal are flying against Man City!📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/cMHbIyJ90D.

Recent findings suggest that had they gone through the gears, there could have been more, but it didn’t matter. What Arsenal revealed was far more significant than a couple of more goals when the game was being disrupted by substitutions. The tackles, the running, energy and commitment – that is what brought Arteta joy.

“I’m extremely happy with the performance, the result and winning the first trophy,” Arteta purred.

You would be brave to say it will be their last.

They pursued Morgan Rogers and Vinicius Junior without success, and Arteta’s desire to take the team to a “different dimension” has so far gone unfulfilled., certainly in the forward positions.

Recent findings suggest that it would have been less stressful for Guardiola to go once he realised the great side of Kevin De Bruyne was nearing its end. Instead he opted to oversee a rebuild that gives his successor a greater chance of immediate success, going close to the title last season in what was effectively year one for a re-emerging City side. Guardiola must have known he was signing Gianluigi Donnarumma, Antoine Semenyo, Marc Guéhi and Rayan Cherki for someone else’s long-term benefit.

The Community Shield returns to Cardiff’s Principality Stadium for the first time since 2006, and a different dynamic is at play between Arsenal and Manchester City.

When the two clubs played at Wembley in this fixture three years ago, it felt like a more significant occasion for Arsenal as they sought to prove that the gap was closing to Pep Guardiola’s champions.

Now it is Arsenal and Mikel Arteta who have a league title behind them, while Enzo Maresca is the manager hoping to build credibility as City turn the page post-Pep Guardiola.

Recent findings suggest that in truth, these two teams will look very different by the time the season gathers pace in autumn. World Cup exertions mean Elliot Anderson, Erling Haaland, Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka will be minimally involved in this game, while transfer plans remain up in the air for both camps.

City appear bound to lose Rodri, in addition to Bernardo Silva and Tijjani Reijnders in central midfield. Rodri’s sale would expedite a move for Lille’s Ayyoub Bouaddi, and possibly Enzo Fernandez despite Chelsea’s insistence that the deadline to sign him for £120m has passed.

It has been revealed that arsenal are also open for business, hoping to add a right-sided defender to help them cope with William Saliba’s absence. The £75m purchase of Bruno Guimarães means the champions’ midfield options look formidable, but so far it has been another summer without a level-raising forward signing. Christos Tzolis in and Leandro Trossard out looks canny business, but falls into the category of like for like.

Industry observers note that although Arsenal held their nerve to see off City in the title race, they failed to win in three attempts against their rivals, including a limp defeat in the Carabao Cup final at Wembley. Arsenal also failed to win, or score, against Liverpool in the Premier League last season so their record in the big games is an area for improvement.

The victors this afternoon will claim to have laid a marker down, the losers will write the game off as a warm up exercise.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sous contrat avec l'ASSE jusqu'en juin 2029 mais prêté cette saison au FC Séville (avec une option d'achat estimée à 25 M€), Lucas Stassin s'est brièvement confié à DAZN avant le derby contre le Betis programmé ce samedi à 18h30.
  • "On est 6e de Liga, je trouve que c'est un bon début de saison.
  • In a recent development, je garde un très, très bon souvenir de Saint-Etienne parce que j'y ai quand même passé une belle saison en Ligue 1 avec un bon derby forcément.

Sous contrat avec l'ASSE jusqu'en juin 2029 mais prêté cette saison au FC Séville (avec une option d'achat estimée à 25 M€), Lucas Stassin s'est brièvement confié à DAZN avant le derby contre le Betis programmé ce samedi à 18h30.

"On est 6e de Liga, je trouve que c'est un bon début de saison. Maintenant, on peut toujours faire mieux. Quand on regarde les matches où on a perdu des points, ça se joue toujours à des petits détails. Il faut voir le positif, on est dans le top 6 et on va essayer de rester dedans toute la saison. Franchement on m'a très bien accueilli. Le team manager ici est très, très cool. Il parle français en plus. je me suis très vite adapté au groupe. Il y a d'autres francophones dans le groupe [notamment Arouna Sangante, Lucien Agoumé et Youssouf Fofana, ndp2], on parle du championnat de France, forcément. On peut parler français entre nous, c'est cool de parler la langue maternelle. On parle des clubs par où on est passé et des joueurs contre qui on a joué.

In a recent development, je garde un très, très bon souvenir de Saint-Etienne parce que j'y ai quand même passé une belle saison en Ligue 1 avec un bon derby forcément. Je garde un très bon souvenir de mes coéquipiers et du staff même s'ils ont changé beaucoup de staff. En Espagne, il y-a forcément les trois grosses équipes [Barça, Real, Atletico, ndp2] alors qu'en France il y a moins ça, chaque année est un peu différente. En Espagne les duels sont quand même un peu plus intensifs. La mentalité est différente sur le terrain, c'est vraiment toujours à 200% du début jusqu'à la fin du match. Techniquement, il y a énormément de bons joueurs en Liga même si en France il y avait déjà énormément de qualités, ça m'avait impressionné quand j'étais arrivé.

Le derby sévillan, on m'en a parlé depuis que je suis là. On en parle beaucoup. On sait que c'est un très, très gros derby. Avec Lyon et Saint-Etienne, je sais forcément l'ambiance qu'il pourrait y avoir, l'enthousiasme, donc j'ai vraiment hâte de voir comment va être l'ambiance ici. On veut surtout essayer de gagner ce derby pour passer une bonne soirée et une bonne semaine. On se prépare beaucoup, on parle beaucoup de ça à l'entraînement. On va aborder ce match avec une bonne envie. Si le fait de pouvoir me distinguer lors du derby peut être vital et intéressant dans la perspective d'être rappelé chez les Diables Rouges ? Ouais, forcément, on a toujours l'objectif de performer en club pour être repris en équipe nationale. La prochaine sélection est en mars, je vais tout faire d'ici-là pour essayer d'avoir des chances d'être repris.".

l’obiettivo non è scavalcare Tavares nelle gerarchie, ma guadagnare la fiducia del tecnico e più minuti, anche a partita in corso. Belahyane ha già saputo sfruttare i problemi di Rovella; ora Pedraza può provare a fare altrettanto durante l’assenza del portoghese.

Industry observers note that le due presenze da titolare di Pedraza risalgono entrambe ad agosto. La prima, contro il Mantova in Coppa Italia, è coincisa con il punto più basso della stagione biancoceleste. Per lo spagnolo sarà anche l’occasione di avvicinarsi al rendimento mostrato al Villarreal, dove ha costruito la propria carriera dimostrando di poter giocare a certi livelli.

Pedraza è tra i pochi nuovi acquisti che non sono ancora entrati nelle grazie dei tifosi. In precedenza, le voci su una possibile partenza di Tavares avevano fatto pensare che potesse diventare lui il titolare.
